issue.title: test_member_loader_reuses_reply_and_prompt_precedence fails: expanded prompt stays the raw research segment

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails every serial run, not only under xdist. Observed in sase tool run check 3acd4d900f214c6830bc663849aed9dd, then again on 092fd1db05, and on a10a6c6035 with the scope-sweep diff stashed. Expected AGENT PROMPT text 'Expanded prompt body'. Actual AGENT PROMPT text is '#research first segment', the same body as AGENT RAW PROMPT. The scope epic does not touch clan aggregation or prompt expansion. No existing task names this node. Discovered while landing sase-1i4.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1i4 landing's just check reported this clan prompt-precedence failure as NEW. It fails serially on current master and with the scope diff stashed, so it is not caused by the agent-scope epic.

payload.description: Found during sase-1i4 landing; clan precedence is outside the scope epic

evidence.note: Proposed by phase sase-1hi.10.7.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 1) as failing on a clean base. The sase-1hi.10.7 land agent reproduced it serially on master 67df4cfba5. Likely the same root cause: tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_agent_session_render.py::test_agent_session_conversation_sections_are_always_full fails at its EXPANDED, EXHAUSTIVE, and override params. Its AGENT PROMPT section never shows the expanded body ('plan prompt line 15') while the raw macro body ('plan macro line 15') does render, the same 'expanded prompt stays the raw segment' symptom. Fix both nodes together.

Proposed by sase-1kh.1 note #1 and sase-1kh.3 note #1. Landing at 1a638eac95 reproduced test_member_loader_reuses_reply_and_prompt_precedence alone, the session full-content hint node alone, and the session conversation-sections node in the phase3 batch. They omit the expanded prompt body and its file hints while AGENT PROMPT shows raw macro text, matching this task and its existing session-render evidence. Terminal raw-prompt/body preview nodes fail with the same raw-in-expanded-body symptom. No epic commit changes prompt selection.

payload.entry: FOLLOW-UP CHECK EVIDENCE: ToolRun 2ece3b5f3bf2b1fb4494dd214c858e6b failed tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_header_panel_preview.py::test_collapsed_preview_shows_quote_bar_and_body_omits_raw_prompt: the AGENT PROMPT body contained the raw prompt text describing the AGENT RAW PROMPT section, consistent with raw macro text appearing in the expanded prompt. tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_raw_prompt.py::TestAgentRawPromptRendering::test_done_agent_renders_raw_prompt also failed its compact AGENT PROMPT section assertion; retaining it as supplementary evidence because the assertion did not print the rendered first content line. These are corroborations only, not new tasks.

payload.description: Match clean-base raw-prompt failures to the existing follow-up

evidence.note: Proposed by E3 phases sase-1ko.7 (notes #8, #10) and sase-1ko.9. sase-1ko land agent reproduced on master 88acef6234: TestAgentRawPromptRendering::test_done_agent_renders_raw_prompt and test_collapsed_preview_shows_quote_bar_and_body_omits_raw_prompt ('AGENT RAW PROMPT' not in expanded body) still fail; E3 does not touch agent display.

payload.description: Adjacent agent-display raw-prompt rendering failures; a shared prompt-precedence root cause is plausible
